topic: how does the TCP handshake work
narration: The internet can lose packets. So before sending data, your laptop and a server must agree they're both ready. That's what the handshake solves.
description: Vertical 1080x1920, same dark style for continuity. Left laptop illustration accent=cyan at x-20% y-45%, right server rack accent2=magenta at x-80% y-45%. Thin horizontal path at y-52% between them. Three small accent=cyan cubes travel laptop to server along path. One vanishes mid-flight with flash. Large fg=white question mark at x-50% y-38% pops over broken stream. Bottom-center dashed pill label. All focal content y-30% to y-65%, clear of top 10% and bottom 25%.
